question: Where are the jar and the world-lords worshipped in the next stage of the rite?
premises: The jar, together with the vessel on its left, is worshipped in the Īśāna direction.
After that, the practitioner turns to the solar direction.
The world-lords are worshipped there together with their weapons.
inference: The ritual proceeds spatially from the Īśāna-direction jar worship to worship of the armed world-lords in the solar direction.
uncertainties: sauradig is taken as the eastern or sun-associated direction.
plain_english: One should worship that jar in the Īśāna direction together with the vessel placed on its left; then, taking position in the solar direction, one should worship the world-lords together with their weapons.
